summary: 12 TCs reviewed; 0 real defects. fetchAll fetches with Bearer; useMemo groups+sorts by category (lines 83-89). onConnect routes by kind: project_apikey opens modal (lines 97-101), personal_oauth POSTs and follows redirect_url if present (lines 103-129). submitApiKey validates draft non-empty before POST (lines 133-135). onSync pulls summary from body.data.summary with fallback (line 171). onDisconnect uses window.confirm (line 181). All actions catch errors and surface via flashToast/apiKeyErr.

defects.description: STATUS_DOT/STATUS_LABEL maps cover 5 statuses; if backend ever returns an undeclared status, lookup yields undefined → undefined-as-CSS / undefined-as-text rendering. Defensive: cast as IntegrationStatus may not catch typo.

notes: DEF-117-02 is a defensive-coding suggestion, not a defect — TypeScript narrows IntegrationStatus to the 5 declared values. Backend type contract enforced; runtime drift would imply a backend bug, not a frontend defect.
